name: Ray Casting with Depth/Alpha Test for Empty Space Skipping
aliases: Empty Space Skipping via OpenGL Tests
Ray Casting using Alpha and Depth Tests
Texture Slab Volume Rendering with GPU-based Acceleration
definition: A ray casting acceleration technique that uses OpenGL's alpha test and depth test to find the near and far intersection points of rays with the volume, allowing samples to be taken only between these points (empty space skipping).
summary: This GPU-based volume rendering technique accelerates ray casting by using OpenGL's alpha and depth tests to skip empty space, avoiding CPU preprocessing or hierarchical data structures.
